cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) has teamed up with Paisabazaar Plus (Rupay) to offer customers easy access to a variety of financial products and services. This partnership allows SBM users to seamlessly explore and apply for credit cards, loans, and other financial offerings through the Paisabazaar platform, powered by the secure Rupay payment network.
